# proxmox_qemu_vms (Data Source)

Lists QEMU virtual machines and templates from `/cluster/resources`. The optional `template`, `name`, and `node` filters are applied by the provider. Guests the authenticated identity cannot audit (VM.Audit) are omitted by Proxmox, and `name`/`template` come from RRD stats, so a guest created in the last minute may be missing from or incomplete in the results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Find a QEMU template by name and clone from it. The `template` flag comes
# from `/cluster/resources`, so a template created within the last minute may
# not appear until Proxmox publishes its RRD stats.
data "proxmox_qemu_vms" "ubuntu_template" {
  template = true
  name     = "ubuntu-24.04-cloudinit"
}

resource "proxmox_qemu_vm" "app" {
  node  = one(data.proxmox_qemu_vms.ubuntu_template.vms[*].node)
  vm_id = 999

  clone = {
    source_vmid = one(data.proxmox_qemu_vms.ubuntu_template.vms[*].vm_id)
    full        = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Exact, case-sensitive guest name match. An empty value disables this filter.
- `node` (String) Exact match against the hosting node. An empty value disables this filter.
- `template` (Boolean) Restrict the result to templates (`true`) or non-template guests (`false`). A guest whose `template` flag is not reported yet counts as a non-template, matching the Proxmox API default of `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `vms` (Attributes List) Matching QEMU guests, sorted by `vm_id` ascending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `max_cpu` (Number) Allocated vCPUs.
- `max_disk` (Number) Allocated root disk size in bytes.
- `max_memory` (Number) Allocated memory in bytes.
- `name` (String) Guest name, when reported.
- `node` (String) Hosting node.
- `pool` (String) Resource pool, when set and auditable.
- `status` (String) Runtime status.
- `tags` (String) Guest tags as a semicolon-separated string, when set.
- `template` (Boolean) Whether the guest is a template; null while Proxmox has not reported the flag yet.
- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric VMID, usable as `clone.source_vmid` or `proxmox_qemu_vm.vm_id`.
